title: Seemeeu Guesthouse · Guesthouse in Yzerfontein
text: Seemeeu Guesthouse. Rooms, Breakfast, The beach, Staying with us. Four rooms, five minutes from the beach. Breakfast on the stoep from 07:30. Dogs welcome in the garden room. Book a room. Four rooms, breakfast included. The beach, a five-minute walk. Dogs in the garden room. Wifi in every room. Our rooms: four rooms, each with its own bathroom, breakfast included. The sea-view doubles, R1,450 a night: two doubles, looking out to sea. The family room, R1,850 a night: a double and two singles. The garden room, R1,250 a night: a double with its own gate to the fenced garden. Dogs welcome here, R150 a night a dog. Breakfast on the stoep: from 07:30 to 10:00, a full farm breakfast, or yoghurt, fruit and fresh bread. The beach and around: the beach is a five-minute walk. Sixteen Mile Beach and the harbour are a short drive, and the West Coast National Park about twenty minutes away. Staying with us: check-in from 14:00, check-out by 10:00. Two nights at least over a weekend from December to February. Parking in the yard, and wifi in every room.
